subject: literacy
concept: Using a specific example or piece of evidence to back up a reason
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student matches example cards to the reason they best support
exercise.pictorial: Student identifies which example is specific versus which is too vague to count as evidence
exercise.abstract: Student writes a claim, a reason, and a specific supporting example

misconception_flags: gives a vague example that doesn't actually support the stated reason

interest_binding: topic generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
